document: OpenDataRemoval Privacy Platform — Frontend Dashboard Specification

stack.theme: Polished — dark/light mode, animated score gauges, colour-coded status badges

design_decisions.state_management: Zustand for client-only global state (auth token, theme, notification badge count, active scan progress). TanStack Query for all server state (profiles, brokers, requests, reports).
design_decisions.theme: Polished dark/light mode toggle. Colour-coded status system: red=exposed/failed, green=removed/confirmed, amber=pending/submitted, blue=informational. Animated circular score gauges.
design_decisions.responsive: Desktop-first 1280px+. Sidebar collapses to icon-only at 768px. Tables become cards on tablet.
design_decisions.token_storage: JWT stored in Zustand memory store only — never localStorage. On page refresh user re-authenticates.
design_decisions.real_time: WebSocket connection managed in Zustand store. SSE managed as hook per active scan view.
design_decisions.api_layer: Centralised axios instance with JWT interceptor. TanStack Query wraps all GET calls. Mutations use useMutation.

routes.guard: admin sees all, member redirected if not own profile

logic: If no token: redirect to /login with state.from = current location
If role check fails: redirect to /dashboard with toast error
After login: redirect to state.from or /dashboard

routing.onboarding_redirect: After login, if admin role and profiles.length === 0: redirect to /onboarding

state.token: string | null — JWT token, in-memory only

actions.login: async(username, password) → calls POST /api/auth/login, sets token + user, returns void
actions.logout: async() → calls POST /api/auth/logout, clears token + user, clears TanStack Query cache

authStore.persistence: None — in-memory only. Token lost on page refresh by design.

actions.toggle: Flips theme. Adds/removes 'dark' class on document.documentElement.

themeStore.persistence: localStorage key opendataremoval_theme — theme preference survives refresh

state.unreadCount: integer — badge number on bell icon
state.recentNotifications: array of last 10 notifications for dropdown preview

actions.updateProgress: (completed, total, latest_result) → update from SSE event

invalidation_strategy.on_websocket_notification: Invalidate based on notification entity_type: exposure→['reports'], request→['requests'], system→['system', 'health']

websocket_hook.description: Manages WebSocket lifecycle. Called once in App.jsx when authenticated.

lifecycle.connect: On mount when token is set. Opens WebSocket. Sets wsConnected=true.
on_message: Invalidate relevant TanStack Query keys based on notification_type
lifecycle.on_error: Set wsError in notificationStore. Attempt reconnect after 5 seconds.
lifecycle.on_close: Set wsConnected=false. Attempt reconnect with exponential backoff: 5s, 10s, 30s, 60s.
lifecycle.disconnect: On logout or token cleared: close WebSocket, clear reconnect timers.

websocket_hook.heartbeat: Client responds to server ping with pong within 5 seconds or connection is considered stale

sse_hook.description: SSE stream for live scan progress. Used only in DashboardPage and ScanProgressBar when a scan is active.

on_message: If event === scan_complete: scanProgressStore.completeScan(), invalidate scan queries, close EventSource
implementation.cleanup: EventSource.close() on component unmount or when scanRunId changes

sse_hook.trigger: Hook activates when scanProgressStore.activeScanRunId is non-null

config.baseURL: '' — relative URLs, Nginx proxies /api/* to FastAPI

interceptors.request: Attach Authorization: Bearer {token} from authStore.token on every request
interceptors.response_401: Clear authStore token, redirect to /login with toast: Session expired. Please log in again.
interceptors.response_429: Show toast: Too many requests — please wait a moment., do not retry automatically
interceptors.response_500: Show toast: Something went wrong. The error has been logged., log to console

colour_system.description: Consistent colour-coded status system across all views

DashboardPage.title: Household Overview
DashboardPage.layout: 2-column grid — left: stats + profile cards, right: recent activity feed
components: StatsRow — 4 cards: Active Exposures (red if > 0), Pending Requests (amber), Confirmed Removed (green), Re-listings (orange if > 0)
ProfileScoreGrid — ScoreGauge per profile with name, last scan time, paused badge if is_paused
ScanProgressBar — visible only when activeScanRunId is set, reads scanProgressStore
RecentActivityFeed — last 10 audit_log events in timeline style
ScanTriggerButton — floating action button for admin users
DashboardPage.websocket: Active — new_exposure and removal_confirmed events invalidate stats

tabs.label: Overview

tabs.label: Brokers

tabs.label: Requests
tabs.content: Paginated removal request list filtered to this profile. RequestStatusTimeline on row expand.

tabs.label: Fields
tabs.content: ProfileFieldList grouped by type (addresses, phones, emails, etc.) with history toggle and AddFieldForm

RequestTrackerPage.title: Removal Request Tracker
RequestTrackerPage.layout: Filter bar + paginated table with expandable row detail
filter_controls: Status tabs — All | Pending | Removed | Failed | Action Required
RequestTrackerPage.row_expansion: RequestStatusTimeline + mail classification if present + Resubmit button if failed/requires_manual
RequestTrackerPage.pagination: Load more button — loads next cursor page

tabs.label: Exposure Score
tabs.content: ExposureScoreChart — date range picker (7d/30d/90d/custom), profile toggle, score value annotations

tabs.label: Field Exposure
tabs.content: FieldExposureBreakdown — profile selector, field type filter, grouped bar chart, summary table below

tabs.label: Re-listings
tabs.content: RelistingTable — broker, profile, original confirmed date, re-list date, days_until_relisting, re-submission status

tabs.label: Audit Log

SystemHealthPage.title: System Health
components: ServiceStatusGrid — 6 service cards (db, redis, worker, playwright, mailwatcher, n8n) with green/amber/red status dots
DiskUsageBars — volume bars for db_data, screenshots, logs with warning colour at 80%
QueueDepthMeter — Celery queue depth with amber warning at 50, red at 200
LastScanTime — last_scan_completed_at with relative time (e.g. 6 hours ago)
ImageVersionTable — service name, current image tag, update available badge
SystemHealthPage.auto_refresh: 30-second refetch — health data stays current without manual refresh

OnboardingPage.title: Welcome to OpenDataRemoval
OnboardingPage.layout: Centred wizard card with step progress indicator

steps.title: Create your admin account
steps.description: Your credentials were set during init.sh. This step confirms your account is active.
steps.action: GET /api/auth/me — display current user details. Button: Looks good, continue.

steps.title: Add your first household member
steps.description: Add yourself or a family member. You can add more profiles later.
steps.action: ProfileFieldForm with name, DOB, at least one address, phone, email required. POST /api/profiles.

steps.title: Verify email configuration
steps.description: OpenDataRemoval sends removal requests from your dedicated removal email address.
steps.action: Display REMOVAL_EMAIL from /api/system/config. Button: Send test email → POST /api/system/test-email. Show success/fail.

steps.title: Check n8n connectivity
steps.description: n8n discovers new data brokers each week. Let's make sure it's reachable.
steps.action: GET /api/system/health — show n8n status. If healthy: green check. Button: Continue. If degraded: show troubleshooting hint.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.description: OpenDataRemoval will now scan for your data daily and automatically request removal.
steps.action: Show summary: profiles added, brokers in registry, next scan time. Button: Run first scan now → POST /api/scans → redirect to /dashboard with scan progress bar active.

OnboardingPage.completion: On finish: write onboarding_complete=true to localStorage. Redirect to /dashboard. Onboarding never shown again.
